case_name: Text on screen in a clip
title: Mountain Morning Opening Title
tests: Checks exact, legible title-card text, its opening placement and duration, and the transition into moving scenery.

faults.what: The delivered clip is not silent: the supplied audio report identifies speech, transcribed as "Somtimes".
At 2.3 seconds the title has disappeared but the screen is still blank dark green, rather than cutting directly from the approximately two-second title to the lake.

judge.summary: The clip has the correct legible title and an attractive moving sunrise lake scene, but unwanted speech and a blank green interval require correction.

must_haves.item: The opening title reads exactly 'A quieter kind of morning', with no quotation marks or extra text.
must_haves.why: The opening frame shows the exact requested wording and no additional text.

must_haves.item: The title is legible cream lettering on a dark green card, fully inside the frame.
must_haves.why: The pale cream title is large, clear, and fully contained within the dark green frame.

must_haves.item: The title card occupies approximately the first 2 seconds, then cuts to the lake scene.
must_haves.why: The 2.3-second frame is blank green, showing an intervening blank interval instead of the requested direct cut to the lake.

must_haves.item: The remaining scene shows a misty mountain lake at sunrise with visible slow camera or scene motion.
must_haves.why: The later frames show low mist over a mountain lake with warm sunrise light, and changes in framing and reflections indicate movement.

must_haves.item: The delivered video is silent, 16:9 and approximately 6 seconds long.
must_haves.why: The frames are 16:9 and the reported duration is six seconds, but the audio report identifies speech, so it is not silent.
